  • Rhomann Dey returns home, and is happily greeted by his wife and daughter.[86][114][111]
  • On the Eclector the Ravagers celebrate their victory, while Yondu Udonta stares at the orb. Yondu opens it, finding a Troll doll in place of the Power Stone.[86][114][111]

20th

  • Having grown a bit bigger, on the Milano Groot begins to dance to "I Want You Back" by The Jackson 5 behind Drax, freezing whenever Drax looks his way.[86]

21st

  • At school, a group of kids start making racist comments toward Xu Shang-Chi, who is using the alias "Shaun." A student calls him "Gangnam Style," and "Shaun" replies that he is not Korean, calling the student an idiot. Katy Chen sees the student drop his backpack and prepare to punch "Shaun." However, before he can, Chen starts screaming the lyrics to "Hotel California" and steals the bully's car keys.[28][116]
  • Chen pulls "Shaun" into the parking lot, revealing that she had stolen the keys. They and Soo go for a joyride near their school.[28][116]

26th

  • Groot, newly replanted after his death during the Battle of Xandar sleeps in his pot in the Milano. He wakes up and yawns as he stretches.[117][118]

September

  • Sullivan begins working for the New York City Police Department.[119]

1st

  • Michael Strahan starts performing in advertisements about digestive health.[3][120]
  • Groot sits inside the Milano, while two machines keep him clean.[117][118]
  • Later that day, Groot continues to be scrubbed by the two machines.[117][118]

3rd

  • Thor and Jane Foster watch a horror movie together. A scare in the movie causes Foster to lean into Thor who brandishes Mjølnir to defend himself.[24][25]

7th

  • Groot continues to grow on the Milano. He notices leaves growing on his shoulders and plucks one off, looking at it.[117][118]

8th

  • On the Milano, Groot sits inside his pot, when it suddenly cracks. A pair of machines move Groot away and put a larger tree in his spot, angering him. Cold, Groot tries to wrap his blanket around himself, but one of the machines takes it and gives it to the tree.[117][118]
  • Angry, Groot throws a Yaro Root at the tree. However, the root ricochets off the tree, causing him to fall. He stops his fall by grabing the table, realizing that he is able to stretch his arms. He climbs back onto the table and grabs the tree, attempting to pull it towards him. However, his arm instead flies back at him, further angering him.[117][118]
  • Groot swings himself to the larger tree and lands on his face before punching the tree, causing it to spin around and hit him. Groot pulls a branch off, thinking himself victorious, but the sap gets wraps around him, pulling him back. Groot hits into the tree, knocking them both of them off the table and shattering their pots.[117][118]
  • Groot comes to find he has grown legs and tries to stand up, at first falling. He sits up and manages to stand. He walks around and starts running happily. He celebrates his victory over the tree, but then feels bad for it.[117][118]
  • Groot wraps the tree in his blanket and sits next to it, eating cheese balls. He puts a cheese ball in the tree's leaves and hits away a machine that tries to clean it.[117][118]

10th

  • Nebula is captured by the Sovereign attempting to steal Anulax Batteries.[121]
  • Star-Lord and Rocket have fun flying together using Aero-Rigs.[121]

11th

  • Phil Coulson, Melinda May and Skye record a birthday message video for Jemma Simmons for her 27th birthday, as she is not at the base with them, instead on an assignment for Coulson at Hydra. They tell her to make a wish and then blow out the candle for her. Leo Fitz, still believing that Simmons left to see her parents, records a more personal message, asking her to say "hi" to her parents for him, and promising her that they will see each other soon.[122]

24th

  • Daniel Whitehall tries to control the agent Kara Palamas after her previous kidnapping.[21][90][123]

25th

  • Agent Jemma Simmons, undercover within Hydra per Phil Coulson's request, goes to her new workplace in Hydra Laboratories.[21][90]
  • In the Playground, Coulson alerts Melinda May that Hydra has captured Agent 33.[21][90]
  • Simmons discovers that Hydra is looking for Donnie Gill, whom she knows from their previous encounter, and that they are studying his abilities.[21][90]
  • In Marrakech, Gill is found by two Hydra agents. He freezes one of them and takes his cell phone.[21][90]
  • Simmons meets with Coulson and tells him about Gill, and that she believes he must have gained some kind of powers after he was struck by lightning.[19] Coulson decides that they must try to recruit Gill before Hydra reaches him.[21][90]
  • Skye tries to get information from Grant Ward. Ward tells her that he was never loyal to Hydra, only to Garrett. He also tells her about Hydra's protocol when it concerns the "gifted", which is to either recruit or kill them.[21][90]
The following section contains information from media marked as Dubious Canon.
  • A psychological evaluation file on Ana Helstrom is reviewed and updated.[67]
This concludes information from media marked as Dubious Canon.

26th

  • Donnie Gill goes to a freighter. He stands near it and freezes the water.[21][90]
  • Sunil Bakshi accuses Simmons of lying for not telling him that she knew about Project Blizzard, the project that gave powers to Gill. She covers by saying that she did not know who the subject of the project was until yesterday, which is true. Bakshi asks if she is loyal to Hydra, to which Simmons simply replies that she is loyal to science.[21][90]
  • Coulson and his team hear about the frozen ship in the sea. They prepare to leave on the Bus.[21][90]
  • Bakshi brings together a group of agents with Simmons to go and find Gill.[21][90]
  • Fitz is shocked when he enters Grant Ward's cell. Ward tries to explain himself to Fitz, to no avail. Furious, Fitz explains what Ward has done to him, and starts draining the oxygen from his cell. Ward tells him that Coulson and the others do not understand that Gill was brainwashed and was used by Hydra to take the Sandbox in one of the battles during the Hydra Uprising. Fitz tells Mack about Gill and that they have to alert Coulson.[21][90]
  • Battle on the Maribel del Mar:
    • At the freighter, Mack calls Coulson and tells him about Gill being brainwashed by Hydra. Coulson orders his team to stop Hydra from talking to Gill to prevent the brainwashing from being triggered again.[21][90]
    • When May notices Simmons, she takes out Hunter so as to prevent him from killing her, as he does not know who she is. Alerted by the noise, Gill runs. Coulson orders his team to maintain Simmons' cover.[21][90]
    • Gill runs into Bakshi, who speaks the brainwashing code to him and Gill falls under his sway. Bakshi orders Gill to freeze the ship, but he is shot by Skye. Gill falls into the ocean.[21][90]
  • Skye monitors channels, trying to learn if someone has found Gill's body. Skye tells May that she does not understand why Coulson did not tell anyone about Simmons, but May simply states that she will handle it.[21][90]
  • Coulson goes to talk to Fitz, reminding him that he is still an important part of the team, but that he saw what he did to Ward. Fitz says that he is not a killer. Coulson explains that he hates Ward as much as him, but they need to find out more about Hydra from him. Coulson reveals to him that Simmons is on assignment, and that is why she has made no contact. He also tells Fitz that is a lot more he is hiding.[21]
  • Whitehall tells Bakshi that S.H.I.E.L.D. is becoming a problem and he wants to know who is in charge. Agent 33 then reveals herself, now brainwashed and loyal to Whitehall.[21][90]
  • Ward reveals to Skye that her father is still alive and he wants to meet with her.[21][90]

October

  • Rite of Blood: PRIDE has a meeting, performing their thirteenth Rite of Blood ritual, where they sacrifice 20-year-old runaway Emily Wong to revitalize Jonah.[58][4]
  • Mallory Book gets married.[124][125]
  • The Brasserie opens in New York City.[126]

5th

  • Battle on Sovereign:
    • The Guardians of the Galaxy are hired by Ayesha, the High Priestess of the Sovereign, to defeat the Abilisk: a beast who is slowly devouring her home planet's power source, the special Anulax Batteries.[121][111]
    • They agree to kill the monster in exchange for Nebula, whom the Sovereign captured not long after the Battle of Xandar.[121][111]
    • The team prepeare for battle as Rocket sets up a sound system to play music.[121]
    • The Abilisk arrives through an Inter-Dimensional Portal, the Guardians begin to battle it. Groot finds the music Rocket had set up, and begins playing "Mr. Blue Sky," gleefully dancing along.[121][111]
    • Drax the Destroyer, beliving the beast's skin to be inpenetrable, allows himself to be swollowed by it, much to Quill and Gamora's shock.[121][111]
    • During the battle, Quill notices a cut on the creature's neck, asking Rocket to get it to look up. Upon Rocket exposing the cut, Gamora uses her sword to stab into the cut and slice down the Abilisk. Drax exits the creature's courpse, beliving himself to be responsible for it's death.[121][111]
  • After the battle, the Guardians meet with Ayesha, and Nebula is handed over as promised.[121][111]
  • They intend to leave Sovereign peacefully, however, Rocket has decided to take some Anulax Batteries for himself. When this is discovered, it angers Ayesha and the Sovereign people.[121][111]
  • Escape from the Sovereign Fleet: The Sovereign send their fleet to chase and attack the Guardians of the Galaxy, heavily damaging the Milano. The group is forced to crash-land on a nearby planet, but before the Sovereign fleet can kill them, it is single-handedly destroyed by Ego. On landing on the planet, Berhert, the Guardians argue, when Ego suddenly lands and reveals himself to be Quill's father.[121][111]
  • On Contraxia, Yondu Udonta has a run-in with Stakar Ogord, nearly 20 years after Ogord banished him for child trafficking. Ogord reiterates Yondu's exile from the greater Ravager community, despite his protests. Ayesha then arrives and hires Yondu to recapture the Guardians.[121][111]
  • Ego invites Quill to return to his home with his protégée Mantis. Quill is cautious, and speaks to Gamora about his concerns regarding Ego's claims, but she reassures him that things will turn out alright. Meanwhile, Drax and Mantis are acquainted.[121][111]

6th

  • Gamora, Drax, and Star-Lord leave with Ego and Mantis to Ego's planet. Rocket and Groot remain to repair the Milano and guard Nebula.[121][111]
  • Mantis demonstrates her empathetic abilities to the trio on Ego's Ship as they travel.[121][111]
  • The Ravagers land on Berhert, where the Milano crash-landed. As they approach the ship to kidnap the Guardians, they step into Rocket's traps.[121][111]
  • Attack on Berhert:
    • Rocket enjoys setting off several traps for them, taking down numerous Ravagers, but he is forced to give in when Yondu Udonta arrives and threatens him with his Yaka Arrow. However, when Yondu shows reluctance to turn Quill over to the Sovereign, some of the group question whether he is being too soft, and Ravager Taserface uses the opportunity to lead a mutiny against him.[121][111]
    • Nebula tricks Groot into releasing her, claiming that she will help, but instead she shoots Yondu's fin, knocking him out and helping the Ravagers. Groot, Udonta, and Rocket are incarcerated on the Ravagers' ship, the Eclector.[121][111]
  • Quill, Gamora, Drax, Ego, and Mantis arrive at Ego's home: a living planet that is an extension of his body. Ego explains that he is a god-like being called a Celestial, and he created a humanoid avatar to travel across the galaxy and interact with other species.[121][111]
  • Yondu Udonta and Rocket are forced to watch as Yondu's loyal men are killed, thrown out the airlock of the Eclector.[121][111]
  • Nebula is given a ship in return for having helped the Ravagers, and leaves to pursue her sister and get revenge on her.[121][111]
  • Ego teaches Quill to access and manipulate the power within his planet, to Quill's amazement.[121][111]
  • Drax becomes friendly with Mantis, who anxiously begins to attempt to reveal a secret about Ego, before being interrupted by Gamora, asking for Mantis to take them to where they will be staying.[121][111]
  • Rocket and Yondu are thrown in a cell, to be delivered to the Kree in the morning. In their imprisonment, Rocket and Yondu discover they are very alike, and Yondu shares his low opinion of Ego, who originally hired Yondu's Ravagers to deliver Quill after his mother's death. Meanwhile, Groot is spared, but humiliated by Taserface's men.[121][111]
  • Once the Ravagers have gone to sleep, Groot walks away, dejected, and goes to Yondu and Rocket's cell. Yondu calls him over, and gives him instructions on how to find a prototype version of Yaka Arrow Controller in the captain's quarters, to aid their escape. Groot excitedly runs off to find it, but Rocket is skeptical as to whether Groot understood the instructions.[121][111]
  • Groot returns, but with Yondu's underwear. They send him back several times, but he does not understand, bringing useless and strange items like a severed toe and a large desk.[121][111]

7th

  • Escape from the Eclector: Soon before the morning, Groot goes one final time to find the fin, but yet again retrieves the wrong item. Kraglin Obfonteri sees this, however, and assists Groot in taking the arrow controller and freeing Yondu, who forgives Kraglin and tells him to prepare the Quadrant for their escape. Together, Rocket, Groot, and Yondu walk through the Eclector to make their escape. The Ravagers are alerted and woken, but as they rush to stop the escape, Yondu uses the Yaka Arrow, controlled by his new fin, to kill all of them. Taserface alerts the Sovereign of the escape, and gives them the coordinates of Ego's planet so they can go after Yondu and the Guardians, before Yondu kills him as well in an explosion ignited by the Yaka Arrow.[121][111]
  • Rocket, Groot, Yondu, and Kraglin escape in a detachable section, and engage in a risky space maneuver of 700 consecutive jumps to reach Ego's planet in time to help Quill.[121][111]
  • Quill, happy to have found his father and his new powers, attempts to get Gamora to dance with him, and she eventually obliges. However, they quickly fall out, as Gamora is upset that Quill is valuing his biological father over the second family he found in their Guardians team. Gamora storms off to sit peacefully on her own in a field.[121][111]
  • Attack on Gamora:
    • Nebula arrives at Ego's planet in the ship from the Ravagers and tries to kill Gamora. Gamora fights back, and the two of them end up fighting in the caverns beneath the planet's surface. Gamora gets the upper hand, but lets her sister live.[121][111]
    • Nebula takes the opportunity to pin down Gamora, but changes her mind about killing her, satisfied with just having beaten her for once.[121][111]
    • The two sisters reach an uneasy truce, and together they explore the caverns beneath Ego's planet's surface.[121][111]
  • Ego and Peter Quill bond over the song "Brandy (You're a Fine Girl)" by Looking Glass. Ego then tells Quill that he wants to show him something.[121][111]
  • Mantis wakes Drax, desperate to warn him about Ego before it is too late, Drax, misreads the situation, and rejects what he belived to be Mantis' advances. Mantis clarifies and tells Drax about all of Ego's children[121][111]
  • Gamora and Nebula are concerned as they approach a sinister cave.[121][111]
  • Ego reveals his master plan to Quill: he travelled the universe and planted seedlings on thousands of worlds, so that he could terraform them into new extensions of himself. However, he needed a second Celestial's power to activate the seedlings, so he conceived children with hundreds of women all across the galaxy and hired Yondu's Ravagers to collect them.[121][111]
  • Meanwhile, Gamora and Nebula discover hundreds of skeletal remains in the cave; the remains of Ego's children.[121][111]
  • Ego reveals that every child of his was killed when they proved unable to access Celestial power, but Quill is the first able to harness the power, and Ego uses him to activate all the seedlings. His "expansion" begins, as he uses Quill to activate the seeds' terraforming, that will eventually consume all those worlds, and every person on them, puting Quill into a trance-like state.[121][111]
  • As Rocket, Groot, Yondu, and Kraglin come to the end of their dangerous 700 jumps, one of the jumps passes by a conversation between the Watchers and one of their informants. Once the interruption has passed, the informant continues telling his tales to the Watchers, from where he's been planted at different points in time.[121][111]
  • Quill is hypnotized by Ego's power until Ego reveals he deliberately caused the death of Quill's mother. Quill breaks free of his trance and fights back.[121][111]
  • On Earth, Xandar, and all other planets that have Ego's seeds, the process of terraforming begins. In Missouri, the source of the Earth seedling, people admire the biomass, but when it begins to grow, the citizens run and drive away as fast as they can.[121][111]
  • One of the people escaping is Jason Quill.[121][111]
  • Battle on Ego's Planet:
    • Mantis informs Gamora, Drax and Nebula of Ego's plan just as Rocket, Groot, Yondu, and Kraglin arrive on the Planet. Yondu sends out the Construction Drilling Vessel, using it as a ship the for the other Guardians. Reunited, the Guardians use the ship's laser to blast through layers of Ego to get to his core and kill him.
    • As the Guardians fight their way through to the core, a fleet of Sovereign Omnicrafts arrives following Taserface's information, to kill the Guardians. The team retaliate against the Sovereign while having to fight Ego himself. The fleet blasts the Laser Drill, causing Drax, Gamora, Nebula and Mantis to fall out of it.[121]
    • Rocket sends Groot into the thick shell at the core of Ego's planet, protecting Ego's brain, to plant a bomb with the Anulax Batteries and kill him. Rocket atempts to explain to Groot which buttons to push, but before he can finish, Groot heads deeper into the core.[121][111]
    • Mantis attempts to keep Ego at bay by trying to make him sleep. Quill lands inside the Laser Drill, shocked to find Yondu inside. Quill and Yondu work to defeat the Sovereign. Their ship is destroyed, but the duo escape unharmed.[121][111]
    • Ego breaks free from Mantis' powers, once again harnessing Quill's powers, causing his expansion to continue. Ego causes the walls to close in on Groot, Nebula and Gamora to be incased into the wall, Rocket to be pulled into the ground and Drax to be burried in sand while attempting to save Mantis. Ego burries Yondu is rocks while Yondu attempts to tell Quill that he used his heart to make his Yaka Arrow fly, but is cut off by Ego.[121][111]
    • Quill regains control, telling Ego that he never should have kill his mother and destroyed his Walkman, attacking Ego, forming his hand into a boulder, bashing Ego's head.[121][111]
    • Ego loses control, and the Guardians are freed, this allows Groot to plant the bomb. Drax arrives at the Quadrant, carring Mantis. Gamora, Nebula, Rocket and Groot all follow suit, while Quill remains to battle his father, using his access to Ego's celestial power.[121][111]
    • When the bomb explodes, Ego dies and the planet collapses. Yondu uses the Aero-Rigs Rocket had given him to save Quill, flying him into the vaccum of space. Yondu tells Quill that even though Ego was his father, he was no his daddy. Yondu gives his Holographic Space Suit to Quill, sacrificing himself as he dies in the vaccum of space.[121][111]
  • Watchers become tired of their informant's stories and walk away, leaving him concerned as to how he will return home.[121][111]
  • Nebula reconciles with Gamora, but chooses to leave anyway, to finds a way to kill Thanos once for all. The two part as caring sisters.[121]
  • The Guardians give Yondu a traditional Ravager funeral, and dozens of Ravagers, including Stakar Ogord, arrive to pay their respects, releasing a string of fireworks. Quill likens Yondu to David Hasselhoff, a childhood hero of his, and realizes that Yondu was his true father figure all along. Rocket is brought to tears upon seeing all the Ravager clans mourn Yondu's passing.[121][127][111]
  • After Yondu's funeral, Quill gifts Kraglin Obfonteri Yondu's Yaka Arrow, saying that he wants him to have it, Kraglin is honored to recive it, calling Quill captain.[121][111]
  • Kraglin Obfonteri tries to use the Yaka Arrow and its controller, but accidentally fires the arrow into Drax's shoulder, causing him to scream in pain.[121][111]
  • The Ravager leader Stakar Ogord is moved by the death of Yondu, his friend and former teammate, and reunites with fellow ex-teammates Charlie-27, Aleta Ogord, Mainframe, and Krugarr, to reform their old team.[121][111]

12th

  • Groot leaves the Benatar on the planet Grundar and climbs a stump. He finds and plays with sticks, leaning them on each other. He then begins work on a fort.[128][111]
  • Five minutes later, Groot finishes work on a large fort, but a Vyloo shakes the fort and steals twigs. Groot tries to get it to leave, but falls off the fort as the Vyloo sits in it. A Manta Bird then comes and takes the Vyloo, destroying Groot's fort and causing Groot to throw a tantrum for the next 37 minutes.[128][111]
  • After falling down from exhaustion, Groot lifts up a rock, finding a city inhabited by Grunds. The creatures until a windstorm casued by Groot speaking blows them all back. Groot stomps playfully, causing massive earthquakes for the terrified Grunds. Groot tosses a rock at them while the Grunds run in terror.[128][111]
  • Battle of Grundar: The Grunds begin to defend themselves by throwing pebbles at Groot. Groot blows on the Grunds, sending them flying away. The Grunds start firing lasers as Groot, hurting him. Scared, Groot farts out a leaf which lands among the Grunds. The Grunds all cheer as they leave the leaf and celebrate their new food source.[128][111]
  • Groot happily goes to retrieve more leaves for them, but accidentally steps on the city, destroying it. Groot covers the destruction with a rock and runs away.[128][111]
  • The Grunds pop their head out of the dirt, having survived Groot's foot.[128][111]

13th

  • Adam Warlock is created by the leader of the Sovereign, Ayesha, in order to find a way to kill the Guardians of the Galaxy.[121]

14th

  • Donny Blaze joins the Masters of the Mystic Arts. He makes a verbal pledge to be a loyal servant of the Mystic Arts.[115][129]

15th

  • The 1987 news story "Perfect End to Historic Season", about Eddie Axton leading the New York Knickerbockers to victory at the 1987 Championship Series, is reprinted in a newspaper.[130][109]
  • Cole North is promoted from police officer to detective for the New York City Police Department.[131][132]

17th

  • On the Quadrant, Groot tries to sleep but is awoken by a noise, angering him.[133][111]
  • Chase of Iwua:
    • Groot angrily leaves his room to investigate, retrieves a Wrist Watch and wraps it around his forehead, turning on the flashlight. He finds a broken glass and a liquid, so he follows the liquid into the bathroom, but finds it empty.[133][111]
    • Groot takes a break searching to use the bathroom, reading as he sits on the toilet.[133][111]
    • Groot leaves the bathroom before checking a shelf and seeing more liquid behind a jar. However, the liquid moves out of the way as he lifts the jar up. He gets suspicious of a nesting doll and opens it, finding only the smaller versions.[133][111]
    • Groot comes across a fruit, believing it to be the being that escaped, and jumps on it, causing the fruit to come out of its peel. As Groot holds the peel, the being moves behind him and the flashlight goes out. Groot struggles to turn it on, and instead takes watch off. Groot hears a crash and sees that the being has broken through a wall.[133][111]
    • Groot goes through the hole in the wall and finds Iwua, who shapeshifts into Groot. The two disagree over who is the real Groot, leading to a dance-off to determine the true Groot. The two enjoy themselves, but Iwua starts to offer Groot dancing tips, so Groot leads Iwua to the air lock and opens it, sending Iwua to die in the vacuum of space. Groot assures himself that he is the real Groot before dancing away.[133][111]

21st

  • "Burnt Offering" by the The Budos Band is released.[3][134]
  • Donny Blaze summons three kegs to Kamar-Taj, along with his former fraternity brother Ky-Dog. He gets kicked out of the Masters of the Mystic Arts and starts performing stage magic.[115][129]

22nd

  • While on Gangalor, Groot exits the Benatar and finds a mud puddle. He tastes mud and approves of it, so he enters the puddle and relaxes. He finds a bug, which he grabs and makes it emit juice that illuminates the mud. Groot puts mud on himself and plants over his eyes. He cheers, waking up a Gangalorian Squirrel Bird, which goes back to sleep.[135][111]
  • As the mud clears, Groot finds that the mud has caused him to grow leaves, so he walks over to a reflective surface and sees that he likes the look.[135][111]
  • Groot trims the leaves to give himself a style and admires himself in the reflection. The leaves die, causing Groot to panic, so he runs back to the mud and puts more on himself, causing more leaves to grow.[135][111]
  • Groot has fun making his leaves into different hairstyles and costumes, angering the Squirrel Bird, which mocks him. Groot, angry, goes to get more mud, but finds that he has run out. He sits in sadness and hugs the leaves as the Squirrel Bird continues to mock him.
  • Robbery of the Gangalorian Squirrel Bird Plumage: Groot takes his anger out on the bird, ripping its fur off and making himself a scarf. As the Squirrel Bird shivers, Groot happily returns to the Benatar with his new scarf.[135][111]

27th

  • Search for the Art Supplies:
    • Groot drags a backpack through the Quadrant and takes a comic from it, ripping out two pages.[136][111]
    • Groot approaches a sleeping Rocket and manages to cut off some of Rocket's fur without waking him.[136][111]
    • Groot takes out a computer disc, causing electronics behind him spark.[136][111]
    • Groot sneaks into the bathroom and finds Drax the Destroyer showering. He enters the shower and discreetly grabs the soap. He drops it and falls on top of it, so he uses it the slide around the Quadrant.[136][111]
    • Drax begins looking for his soap.[136][111]
    • Groot brings the remainder of his art supplies into a room and places down the comic page, which he paints white. He glues rockets fur to the paper and uses the soap to color part of it purple.[136][111]
    • Groot smiles as he uses a booster to weld part of the project.[136][111]
    • Groot creates a bomb using the stolen electronic, causing an explosion, the debris from which Groot uses to decorate his art project. He nearly falls into the crater caused by the bomb, so he gets duct tape to try and patch it up.[136][111]
    • Rocket, awoken by the explosion, looks for Groot and notices the smoke and runs into the room. Rocket calls for Groot and finds that he is alright, noticing the stolen supplies, damaged wall, and Drax's soap. Groot confesses that he caused the explosion and Groot then shows Rocket his art, a picture depicting his sacrifice during the Battle of Xandar.[136][111]
    • Rocket says his art is nice and wants to frame it, saying that he cannot stay mad at Groot. Groot leaves on the soap as Rocket recognizes his tail fur, but is interrupted by the floor giving in. Rocket is saved by Groot, but Groot's art is sucked into space.[136][111]
    • Groot's artwork and art supplies float through space.[136][111]

28th

  • Art Flowers: Contemporary Floral Designs and Installations is published.[3][137]

30th

  • April Van Kempen is born to Dr. Levi Van Kempen.[138][57]

31st

  • Thor and Jane Foster go to a Halloween party, dressed as a hot dog and a murdered girl.[24][25]

November

1st

  • As they enter their apartment in the early hours, returning home from a Halloween party, Thor hugs Jane Foster and the two laugh before heading to their bedroom.[24][25]
  • Thor watches as Foster sleeps, telling Mjølnir how incredible she is. He asks Mjølnir to promise it would protect her, before telling Mjølnir that he loves him. Mjølnir understands the requested promise as an enchantment.[24][25]
  • Rescue of the Terma Baby Bird:
    • While on the planet Terma, Groot explores the woods and comes across a large egg. Groot inspects the egg, and it hatches a baby Terma Bird. The baby playfully bites Groot, who feeds it Gear Shift Candies, causing the baby to run around with joy. Groot admires the baby as they eat the candies together.[139][111]
    • Groot attempts to teach the bird to speak, but it stares at him blankly. Groot burps and the baby imitates him, causing it to fall into mud.[139][111]
    • Groot cleans the mud off of the baby, but it runs away, pooping on the floor as Groot struggles to catch it. THe bird wraps Groot's arm around his body and runs away.[139][111]
    • Groot attempts to quite the baby down, but to no avail. He ties the baby to his head and feeds it another candy to calm it down, but runs out. Groot finds water and drinks some, but as the bird goes to drink some, it pops the droplet. The baby poops on Groot, disgusting him.[139][111]
    • Groot tries to lay down, but the baby continues being loud. Frustrated, Groot resorts to putting the baby into his fanny pack. However, dozens of other babies run at Groot, who runs away. The birds see their mother and run past Groot. The babies return to their mother before flying away. Groot looks on, tearfully saying goodbye, and the bird gives him a candy.[139][111]

2nd

  • Matt Murdock attends confession at Clinton Church and meets with Father Paul Lantom. Murdock recounts some stories of his father, before asking Lantom for forgiveness for what he was about to do, referring to his choice to return to his masked persona.[140][141]
  • Rescue of Kidnapped Women: Murdock, as a masked vigilante, tracks down Turk Barrett and some Russian gangsters as they kidnap a number of women to be placed into a shipping container and sold into sexual slavery. Barrett demands that the woman quiet down, but Murdock attacks him and his men, managing to fend them all off and instructing the women to get to safety. Barrett takes a shot at the vigilante, but Murdock dodges it and brutally incapacitates Barrett.[140][141]

3rd

  • The Masked Man defeats three thugs, who are then admitted to Metro-General Hospital, and tended to by Claire Temple.[142][141]

5th

  • Interstellar is released, featuring an explanation of Einstein Rosen-Bridges which Jane Foster finds to be clear.[3][24]

6th

  • The Foster Theory: Space and Time Travel by Jane Foster is published.[24][143]
  • Search for the Game Batteries:
    • On board the Quadrant, Groot mindlessly plays his video games until his controller runs out of battery. Groot gets up to look for more batteries but instead comes across Rocket's box of artificial body parts. A cybernetic nose gets attached to Groot's face upon looking inside the box, and for the first time, Groot is able to smell the flowers nearby.[144][111]
    • Groot runs all around the ship, enjoying what it is like to smell all of them for the first time. He smells an air freshener, a highlighter, and the toilet. He smells a scented candle and tries to eat it, but is disgusted by it. He realizes that he smells bad and puts on deodorant. He smells a comic and sneezes on it, then smells several foods.[144][111]
    • Groot throws a glass of wine onto a device on the wall of the Quadrant, breaking it. Groot sees batteries handing out of it and takes them, putting them in his controller. Groot returns to his room and gets overwhelmed by the smell. He hastily runs over to a feather duster and uses it to remove the nose before returning to his gaming.[144][111]
  • A nineteen-year-old waitress is assaulted by a man, but she is rescued by the Masked Man. She is then admitted to Metro-General Hospital and meets Claire Temple. This causes Temple to see the good the Masked Man is doing.[142][141]

9th

  • Matt Murdock wakes up in his apartment to the sound of Foggy Nelson calling him. Over the phone, Nelson demands Murdock get up and be ready to see their potential new office.[140][145]
  • As he walks to the office, Nelson meets with Brett Mahoney, and as a bribe, gives him some cigars to give to his mother in exchange for any tips about potential clients.[140][145]
  • The duo meet with realtor Susan Harris, who awkwardly guides Murdock around the space. After the group discussed the low price range, Nelson and Murdock agreed to move in.[140][145]
  • Karen Page, trusting her coworker Daniel Fisher, invites him to go out for drinks at Three Roads Bar and discuss Page's discovering of Union Allied Construction's money laundering.[140][145]
  • After feeling dizzy, Page passes out.[140][145]
  • Murder of Daniel Fisher: Rance, under orders from Wilson Fisk, kills Fisher and stages it to appear as if Page had killed him.[140][145]
  • Page wakes up in her apartment, covered in blood and next to Fisher's dead body. The police bust down the door and arrest Page for the suspected murder.[140][145]
  • Brett Mahoney calls Nelson and Murdock to tell them about Page, who could become their first client.[140][145]

10th

  • Shortly after midnight, Foggy Nelson and Matt Murdock arrive at the 15th Precinct Police Station to meet with Karen Page, wanting to represent her. Page questions their experience and they admit they have only been practicing law for about seven hours. Despite this, Page tells them her story, and Murdock uses his enhanced senses to know that she is telling the truth, so the pair agree to take her case.[140][145]
  • James Wesley approaches Clyde Farnum as he sits in a park. Wesley tasks Farnum with killing Page and faking her suicide before she can reveal any information. Wesley blackmails Farnum by reminding him that a hired gun is watching his daughter. Farnum begrudgingly agrees for the sake of his daughter.[140][145]
  • At their office, Nelson and Murdock discuss the case, with Nelson suggesting they would lose it if it were to go to trial due to Page's obvious guilt. Murdock insists that he feels that she is telling the truth, but Nelson retorts that Murdock's judgment of clients is not always the best, but he decides to trust his partner.[140][145]
  • That night, as Page was sleeping in her cell, Farnum attempts to strangle her with a bedsheet, but she is able to fight him off and scratch out one of his eyes before screaming for help.[140][145]

11th

  • Foggy Nelson and Matt Murdock learn of the assassination attempt, return to the 15th Precinct Police Station and confront officers Christian Blake and Carl Hoffman to ensure Karen Page was released from custody, as she was no longer safe with the police. The officers angrily agree, on the grounds that she had been in danger while in their care, and that they had failed to press charges. As they left, Blake threatened Murdock.[140][145]
  • On board the Benatar, the Guardians of the Galaxy arrive on Falligar.[146][111]
  • Inside the ship, Groot makes himself a cup of hot chocolate. As the Benatar lands, he sees the snow outside and excitedly puts on his snow gear.[146][111]
  • Groot runs onto the ice and enjoys sliding around. He makes snow angels and shakes a tree of icicles, causing them to fall on him. Groot then plays with snowballs, throwing one at the Benatar despite the warning not to.[146][111]
  • Groot builds a snowman and decides to decorate it using spare parts from the Benatar.[146][111]
  • Destruction of the Killer Snowbot: Groot returns to the snowman and installs the spare parts, accidentally causing it comes to life and attack Groot. Groot throws a snowball at it, causing the Snowbot to add snow to itself and increase its size. The Snowbot then targets the Benatar. Realizing his hot chocolate is in danger, Groot acts quickly and throws a snowball at the robot's head, containing the same part with the warning not to throw snowballs, causing it to self-destruct. Groot celebrates, but gets hit with snow and returns as part of the Snowbot reactivates.[146][111]
  • As night falls on Falligar, Groot sips his hot chocolate but is disgusted by it and shoves it to the side. It hits Rocket, who scolds Groot.[146][111]
  • At the Nelson and Murdock Law Office, the duo help to make Page feel comfortable before asking her for all she knows about who might want to kill her and why. She divulges that she had discovered that her employer, Union Allied Construction had been laundering money, and that she had been found out by her boss, McClintock. The group agreed that Page's apartment was unsafe, so Matt said she could stay with him.[140][145]
  • In Murdock's apartment, Murdock offers Page some clean clothes. Page asks if he was born blind, and Murdock tells her that he was blinded as a boy, Murdock then asks her if she still has the incriminating files on Union Allied, and she lies, saying she does not.[140][145]
  • Confederated Global Investments members James Wesley, Nobu Yoshioka, Madame Gao, Leland Owlsley, Anatoly and Vladimir Ranskahov meet on a rooftop and discuss the Russian's recent encounter with a Masked Man. The Ranskahov brothers, not appreciating being questioned, instead ask Wesley about the Union Allied situation, but Wesley assured everyone that it would be handled.[140][145]
  • Later, Page sneaks out of Murdock's apartment and returns to her own, attempting to collect the drive that contains the incriminating files.[140][145]
  • Attack on Karen Page:
    • As Page leaves her apartment, she is attacked by Rance, who rammed her into a wall, and stole the drive. He then approached Page with a knife and attempted to kill her, however he was thwarted when the Masked man arrived and pushed Rance away.[140][145]
    • After a violent altercation, the masked man is able to subdue Rance by using a chain to tie him up and knock him out. the man falls down the ground, tired, but then gets up and retrieves the drive. Page warns the masked man that the NYPD were to corrupt to be trusted.[140][145]
  • The masked man instead delivers Rance and the flash drive to the doorstep of the New York Bulletin Building.[140][145]

14th

  • The New York Bulletin publish the story on the Union Allied Construction scandal.[140][145]
  • Arranged by James Wesley, McClintock overdoses on pills, and his death is made to appear as an accident.[140][145]
  • Wesley sits in his limousine and reads the Bulletin's paper on the scandal. With his boss on the phone, Welsey gives the details of McClintock's death, as well Clyde Farnum's bail, and Rance's capture, adding that he will make arranges for both remaining men to be killed, with their deaths made to appear as a suicide. Fisk decides to allow Wesley to spare Karen Page, due to all the info she had already being in the papers, but asks Wesley to begin looking into Nelson and Murdock.[140][145]
  • Page makes her grandma's recipe for Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson to celebrate their success. Page offers to work for them as repayment for their help, and the group jokes about her working for free.[140][145]
  • At closing time, Murdock goes to Fogwell's Gym and trains with a punching bag.[140][145]
  • Leland Owlsley transfers all of Union Allied's funds into other shell companies owned by Confederated Global Investments.[140][145]
  • Tracy Farnum returns home to do her laundry, but is horrified to find her father dead, after an apparent suicide.[140][145]
  • Rance is found dead in his cell after he was killed by Fisk's men, who make his death appear to be a suicide via hanging.[140][145]
  • Madame Gao oversees the steady production of Steel Serpent in warehouse.[140][145]
  • Nobu Yoshioka and his men look over some blueprints.[140][145]
  • Vladimir Ranskahov and some gangsters assault a man and kidnap his young son by throwing him into the back of thier van.[140][145]
  • Murdock, as the masked man, sits on a rooftop and hears the screams of the young boy, and begins his search.[140][145]

15th

  • John Healy meets with Turk Barrett and is shown the pistols that Barrett is selling. Healy selects one and Barrett assures him it will not jam.[147][145]
  • In Kandahar, Afghanistan, with only 29 days remaining of his rotation, Frank Castle receives a card from his family back home for his birthday. He opens it and is delighted to see that his wife, Maria, has bought him tickets to see Bruce Springsteen perform live.[63][64]
  • Castle is called in with Russo to have a mission briefing with Agent Orange and Ray Schoonover. Agent Orange explains the plan, but Castle expresses disapproval, highlighting that the fact that the target they have been after for months has suddenly shown up likely means it is a trap, as the Afghans have become aware of their operation. Agent Orange overrules him and tells him to proceed, and Castle reluctantly agrees, warning that he thinks people will die.[63][64]
  • Ambush in Kandahar: As Castle predicted, when the Cerberus Squad arrive at the location, they are ambushed. Several members of the squad are killed, and Castle realizes that enemy mortars will soon target them. He decides he has to act and enters the opposition's compound alone, forced to kill numerous insurgents, shooting them and then using his combat knife once he runs out of ammunition. With the insurgents dead, the squad can fall back to a safe location where a helicopter can evacuate them.[63][64]

16th

  • Back at the Cerberus Squad Compound, Castle vomits from the physical exhaustion and horror of the events of the ambush. Agent Orange returns, but shows complete apathy at the deaths of the men, simply asking if they managed to kill the target. Castle is enraged at the man and attacks him brutally in anger, punching him in face and blinding him in one eye. Billy Russo rushes to hold him back and pulls him aside, telling him that no matter how unethical Agent Orange is, he will never be blamed as the blame always falls on the soldiers. Protecting you, it's never on them. He informs Castle that he is transferring back to the Marine Force by request.[63][64]
  • Chase of the Intergalactic Ice Cream Truck:
    • On board the Quadrant, Groot plays with his toys, but hears an Intergalactic Ice Cream Truck's jingle play. Groot is amazed by all the bright colors and ice cream flavors, so he runs to his piggy bank for Units. However, he drops his only coin into a grate.[148][111]
    • Groot attempts to use a vacuum to suck the coin back out but is unsuccessful and accidentally vacuums himself.[148][111]
    • Groot checks under a couch, only finding a moldy pizza. He looks to the nearby claw machine, and jumps inside, finding many coins. However, he realizes the coins are chocolate and has a tantrum, knocking the machine over. Real coins from the machine getting played fall out, exciting Groot.[148][111]
    • Groot returns to the window but is too late as the ice cream truck leaves. Groot jumps into a space pod and blasts off, crashing into the truck and destroying it.[148][111]
    • Groot enjoys an Arishem the Judge themed ice cream as several members of the Nova Corps arrive and scan the wreckage.[148][111]
  • The Masked Man attempts to rescue the boy kidnaped by the Russian Mafia but is ambushed and left for dead in a dumpster.[142][145]
  • Santino discovers the masked man in the dumpster and alerts Claire Temple.[142][145]
  • Temple and Santino carry the man into Temple's apartment, and Temple tells Santino to go home.[142][145]
  • Temple began tending to the man and assessing his injuries, discovering he has broken ribs and that his eyes do not respond to light. She attempts to call 911 but the man awakens and stops her before passing out once again.[142][145]
  • At the Nelson and Murdock Law Office, Karen Page, who is closing up, startles Foggy Nelson, who is singing in his office. Nelson and Page decided to take their minds off of things by meeting with Murdock and the bar.[142][145]
  • Murdock wakes up in Temple's apartment, upset to learn that she has seen his face. She questions his situation, but he neglects to answer her questions. She chooses to call him "Mike," and tells him to rest for now.[142][145]
  • Murdock wakes up and gasps for air. Temple runs over to figure out what is wrong and is able to prevent him from suffocating. Temple again asks for an explanation, and Murdock reveals that his is a vigilante and explains that he was ambushed while trying to save the kidnapped boy. Murdock hears a man walking through the building and alerts Temple.[142][145]
  • Murdock grabs a knife to attack the man at the door, but Temple talks him out of it, instead playing it cool. The man introduces himself as "detective Foster" and asks if she has any information on the masked man. She tells him that she doesn't, so he leaves. Murdock follows "Foster" and knocks him out with a fire extinguisher.[142][145]
  • Murder of Prohaszka: Under orders from Wilson Fisk, John Healy arrives at Whitestone Lanes and requests a bowling lane, but he is denied as they are about to close. He notes that Prohaszka is bowling, but the clerk tells Healy that he has a deal with the owner. Healy approches Prohaszka and asks to join his game, but is denied. Prohaszka's men try to remove Healy, but he fights back, and draws his gun on Prohaszka. His gun jams, so the pair fight over a bowling ball and ultimatly Healy is able to beat Prohaszka to death with it.[147][145]
  • Healy hides the gun under a pinball machine as the police arrive to arrest him. He surrenders and is arrested.[147][145]

17th

  • In the early hours, Page and Nelson arrive at Josie's Bar. The pair joke about here being an eel at the bottom of the bottle of alcohol, so keep drinking until they get to the bottom. Page admits that she is scared to return to her apartment, as it just reminds her of Daniel Fisher's murder and Rance's attempts to kill her. Nelson cheers her up by introducing her to the cast of patrons at the bar.[142][145]
  • Murdock ties "Foster" up on the roof. Murdock asks Temple why she helped him, and she replies that its because she is a nurse, and she has had patients who were saved by the masked man.[142][145]
  • Karen Page and Foggy Nelson knock on Matt Murdock's Apartment and yell for him to come out. Matt's neighbor Fran asks them to quiet down so they choose to bar hop the rest of the night.[142][145]
  • On the rooftop of Claire Temple's Apartment building "Foster" wakes up. Murdock interrogates him and demands the location of the kidnaped boy. Temple aids Murdock in torturing him. "Foster" gives up the location of the boy, but Murdock throws him off the room. Murdock tells Temple to get somewhere safe now that "Foster" knows where she was staying.[142][145]
  • Rescue of the Kidnapped Boy: Using the information "Foster" gave him, Murdock locates the kidnapped boy and after a lengthy fight between Murdock and nine thugs in the hallway leading to the room the boy is kept in, Murdock emerges victorious. Murdock reaches the boy and removes his mask, telling him he will keep the boy safe.[142][145]
  • Murdock takes the boy and brings him back to his father, safe and sound.[142][145]
  • In the morning, Murdock sits outside Clinton Church and is met by Paul Lantom, who offers to have coffee sometime. Murdock suggest they go another time.[147][145]
  • Ben Urich meets with former mobster Silvio on the docks outside the city. Urich asks if he has any information on the recent uptick in organized crime, and Silvio tells him how Don Rigoletto was killed by a new unknown crime boss, and tells Urich that for his own safety he is leaving for Florida.[147][145]
  • Page and Nelson arrive at the Nelson and Murdock Law Office, admitting they regret staying out the night prior. They are joined by Murdock before they hear a knock at the door from James Wesley.[147][145]
  • Wesley meets with the duo and sings of praises of the pair's previous work, and asking them to defend Healy by meeting him at the 15th Precinct Police Station. Murdock is suspicious of the whole ordeal so decides to follow Wesley.[147][145]
  • Murdock follows Wesley in the street and witnesses him getting into a car with his mysterious employer.[147][145]
  • Nelson and Murdock meet with Healy, who recounts the ordeal with Prohaszka. Nelson finds Healy to be insincere and unremorseful. But to his surprise Murdock suggest they take the case.[147][145]
  • At the New York Bulletin Building, Urich speaks with an employee at Metro-General Hospital and requests and extension for his wife's care. Mitchell Ellison comes into his office and attempts to talk Urich down from doing so many stories on organized crime.[147][145]
  • Nelson and Murdock question Healy on the case, and when he answers flippantly, Nelson asks for an aside with Murdock. Nelson questions the validity of this case, but Murdock says they will take it to a jury.[147][145]
  • Wesley goes to the bowling alley and retrieves the gun that Healy left there.[147][145]
  • Back at the office, Nelson and Murdock build a case, noting that Healy has injuries, which helps them build a case that he acted in self defense.[147][145]
  • Page meets with Kirschner & Braun and they ask her to sign an NDA regarding Union Allied Construction following her involvement in the scandal, but Page is feels insulted and that they are trying to silence her, so she doesn't sign it.[147][145]
  • At Metro-General Hospital, Urich asks Shirley Benson for help with the insurance extension, and after much convincing she agrees to see what she can do.[147][145]
  • Murdock and Nelson work on the case despite having issues with the wi-fi. Page shares her findings on Confederated Global Investments, that it is a shell company for a holding company and so on.[147][145]

18th

  • LittleBigPlanet 3 is released.[3][84]
  • A member of the Black Widows puts on a Black Widow's Bite and a belt with the Widows' logo on it. She holsters a gun.[107][108]
  • A group of Widows line up and turn to their right, before standing at attention.[107][108]

20th

  • The People v. John Healy: On day one of John Healy's trial Foggy Nelson gives the opening argument. Meanwhile, Murdock notices the elevated heartbeat of one of juror #8.[147][145]
  • After the trial is over, the juror goes home, but is interrupted by Oscar blackmailing her, asking her to keep it together for the end of the trial tomorrow.[147][145]
  • The Masked Man attacks Oscar and forces him to destroy the source of the blackmail and questions him on his employer. Oscar says all he knows his the job, not the employer.[147][145]

21st

  • Darren Cross posts on Google+ saying "The ability to create life artificially with such ease? Times are indeed changing. (Link - http://www.wired.com/2014/11/opentrons-bio-robots/)".[149]
  • On board the Benatar, the Guardians of the Galaxy arrive on Drez-Lar. Eager to witness the fulfillment of a great prophecy, Watcher watches as Groot enters the Ancient Drez-Lar Temple.[150][111]
  • Destruction of the Ancient Drez-Lar Temple:
    • Groot sets off a trap, but it misses him. He jumps from pressure plate to pressure plate, activating all the traps, which causes the temple to begin spewing lava, threatening the safety of the last Seed of Drez-Lar. Groot chases after a ball, upsetting the Watcher. Groot finds the mural depicting the prophecy he is destined to fulfill and begins coloring on it and then urinates on it, disappointing Watcher.[150][111]
    • The lava inches closer to the seed, as Groot puts on a little puppet show. Watcher watches, growing stressed as Groot takes a quick nap. Sunlight from outside wakes Groot up, and he makes his way to the seed, only to collect his bouncy ball, which had been launched onto the seed. Watcher panics as the seed is engulfed by the lava and the temple begins to crumble.[150][111]
  • Groot survives the destruction and emerges from the rubble, causing Watcher to realize that the prophecy was merely metaphorical. Groot returns to the Benatar and waves goodbye as it leaves the planet.[150][111]
  • The People v. John Healy: On day two of John Healy's trial, juror #8 is relived of service due to the blackmailing. Matt Murdock listens to the heartbeats of the jury to confirm if they compromised. Murdock gives his argument, arguing that morality is complex and the facts of the case show that the prosecution has was unable to prove Healy's actions were not self defense.[147][145]
  • Elsewhere, Leland Owlsley questions James Wesley on Wilson Fisk's whereabouts, and Wesley dismisses him. Leland questions how they will deal with Healy without juror #8. Wesley reminds him of the trail of bodies they have been leaving, wanting Healy to get out of this legally.[147][145]
  • Karen Page finds Daniel Fisher's wife, Jennifer Fisher and attempts to get her to work with her on bringing down Union Allied Construction, but Fisher reveals that she had already signed the NDA so she is unable to help, adding that Page should let it go before it gets her killed too.[147][145]
  • Page goes to the New York Bulletin and finds Ben Urich in his office. She tells him that she has more info on the story of Union Allied.[147][145]
  • The jurors of Healy's trial fail to come to a verdict. Nelson worries that they will take it to a retrial, but Murdock discovers that another juror was blackmailed, so realizes that Healy's victory was guaranteed.[147][145]
  • Attack on John Healy: Healy, now free, is attacked by the masked man, who interrogates him and forces him to give up the name of his employer; Wilson Fisk. Distraught that he had given up Fisk's name, Healy kills himself by impaling his head on a piece of metal.[147][145]
  • Fisk admires a painting at Scene Contempo Gallery. He is approached by Vanessa Marianna, who Fisk instantly finds an attraction to. Marianna sells the painting to Fisk.[147][145]

23rd

  • The Masked Man hunts down the Ranskahov brothers. He finds Anatoly, who manages to escape.[126][145]
  • Murdock goes to the apartment where Claire Temple is staying so she can tend to his wounds. Temple suggests Murdock get some body armor, and Murdock is flattered by her showing her care for him. Murdock gives her the phone number for his burner phone and asks her to call it if she needs anything before leaving.[126][145]

24th

  • James Wesley arrives at the Veles Taxi Garage to meet with Anatoly and Vladimir Ranskahov. He informs the men that Prohaszka's Kitchen Cab has been absorbed into the Russian's Veles Taxi. Wesley also berates the men for failing to deal with the Masked Man, the brothers end the conversation, feeling disrespected.[126][145]
  • Karen Page and Ben Urich meet in at Square Diner. Page recaps the details of her case and her involvment with Union Allied Construction. Urich tells her to move on, for her own safety, but Page refuses, saying that there must be a trail back to the man in charge.[126][145]
  • The Ranskahov brothers go to Semyon's room in Metro-General Hospital and wake him up. Semyon tells the that it was the masked man who put him in the hospital, and gives them the location of the apartment where he found him.[126][145]
  • Sergei and Dmitry are sent to search the apartment, but are seen by Santino. They capture the young man and torture him until he gives them Temple's location.[126]
  • While driving, Wesley discusses his prior meeting with Russians with Wilson Fisk. He admits that Anatoly may be less confrontational that his brother. Once they arrive at Scene Contempo Gallery, Fisk steps out.[126][145]
  • Inside the gallery, Fisk finds Vanessa Marianna, and asks her out on a diner date, to which she accepts.[126][145]
  • Kidnapping of Claire Temple: As Claire Temple relaxes at home, she is kidnapped by the Russians.[126][145]
  • Foggy Nelson and Matt Murdock leave their office for the night. Nelson questions if a leaving Landman and Zack was a good idea, wishing he wasn't so broke. Nelson heads home as Murdock gets a call from Temple, saying she is in trouble. Murdock runs to find her.[126][145]
  • Finding her apartment empty he tries to listen for her, hearing her being held at the Veles Taxi Garage.[126][145]
  • Page attends an auction of Union Allied's assets and attempts to draw the attendees. Urich arrives to save her, advising her to bid on something, as to not draw any suspicion.[126][145]

25th

  • Kidnapping of Claire Temple: The Russians bring Claire Temple to the Veles Taxi Garage.[126][145]
  • Matt Murdock finds Santino outside of Claire Temple's Apartment. He asks him what happened and Santino explains the situation.[126][145]
  • At the Brasserie, Wilson Fisk and Vanessa Marianna enjoy a date together. Fisk recounts the story of his childhood spent abroad in China and how much he valued those years away from New York City.[126][145]
  • Kidnapping of Claire Temple: The Russians interrogate Temple and demand she reveal what she knows about the Masked Man, but she refuses, as she doesn't know who he is. The light go out and the masked man begins attacking the Russians. A shootout ensues as the men struggle to even locate the masked man in the darkness. Temple crawls under a car for safety as bullets fly everywhere. The last remaining Russian attempts to scare the masked man by threatening to kill Temple, but Murdock is able to break his arm and immobilize him. He hugs Temple to comfort her as she begins crying from the trauma of the situation.[126][145]
  • After the auction, Karen Page finds Ben Urich at Square Diner. Page tells him she won a bid on some office equipment, which Urich says saved her life. Page questions why Urich was there, and deduces that Urich is interested in perusing the case. Urich says this can only proceed if Page keeps it a secret and follows his instructions, telling her to sign the NDA that Kirschner & Braun had given her.[126][145]
  • Anatoly and Vladimir Ranskahov asses the aftermath of the fight with the man in the mask. Anatoly assures his brother that they need to work with Fisk, and agrees to meet with him and accept his deal.[126][145]
  • Anatoly interrupts Fisk and Marianna's dinner date, which enrages Fisk. Fisk escorts Mariana away and urges Wesley to get Anatoly in a car.[126][145]
  • Page tells Nelson about the money she spent on the office supplies at the auction, and is surprised when Nelson is excited about it.[126][145]
  • Murdock tends to Temples wounds at his apartment. She questions his medical prowess, and he admits that he used to patch up his dad. Murdock apologizes for putting Temple in this situation, and Temple says its okay, since helping him was her choice. She assures him that he is doing the right thing in trying to save the city, so he reveals that his name is Matthew.[126][145]
  • Fisk apologizes to Mariana about the interruption, admitting that he doesn't go out much, but would like to try it again. She says she doesn't know how to feel.[126][145]
  • Murder of Anatoly Ranskahov: In the car, Wesley questions Anatoly on the situation with the man in the mask. He adds that he wishes to continue his work with Fisk, however, when the car stops, Fisk rips the door open and throws Anatoly to the ground, before slamming the car door into his head repeatedly, decapitating him. Fisk orders Wesley to send the body to Vladimir, and make it appear as if the masked man had killed him.[126][145]
  • In the morning, Temple wakes up in Matt Murdock's Apartment, and is greeted by Murdock as he gets ready for work. He assesses her injuries and explains his powers after being asked about them. He asks her to stay here for her own safety.[151][145]
  • Anatoly's body is delivered to Vladimir Ranskahov as he meets with James Wesley. Ranskahov is devastated to find his brother's body decapitated, but discovers a part of the Masked Man's mask, vowing revenge.[151][145]
  • As Fisk's car is cleaned of Anatoly's blood, Fisk and Wesley meet with Madame Gao, Leland Owlsley, and Nobu Yoshioka to discuss the murder of Anatoly. He tells the others that it was a personal matter and that business will continue as normal without the Russians.[151][145]
  • Some Russian mobsters drive one of Gao's blind drug runners to the Veles Taxi Garage, but are attacked by the Masked Man. Murdock interrogates the men for Vladimir's location, and learns the Russians believe he killed Anatoly. The NYPD arrive and arrest the men, including Piotr.[151][145]

26th

  • At their office, Matt Murdock, Foggy Nelson, and Karen Page struggle to get the office supplies she bought working. Elena Cardenas arrives and asks for assistance.[151][145]
  • Cardenas explains that Armand Tully keeps raising the rent of her apartment building. She tells the lawyers that she wishes to stay in her home, and they agree to help.[151][145]
  • Murdock goes to the 15th Precinct Police Station to ask Brett Mahoney for help, but overhears officers Christian Blake and Carl Hoffman interrogating Piotr, ending in them killing Piotr and making it look like he attacked them first after he gives up that Wilson Fisk is his employer.[151][145]
  • Nelson and Page head to the Landman and Zack Building to speak with Tully's lawyer, Marci Stahl, Nelson's ex. Stahl simply dismisses the pair's claims about Cardenas' building, saying it needs renovation.[151][145]
  • James Wesley informs Fisk on the situation with Blake and Hoffman.[151][145]
  • Nelson and Page go to Cardenas' apartment, and promise to pull some favors and help her fix it.[151][145]
  • The Masked Man finds Blake outside the precinct, and interrogates him on killing Piotr. Blake admits he did it because he mentioned Fisk, and that he doesn't know anything more. Murdock takes Blake's burner phone before leaving.[151][145]
  • Vanessa Marianna arrives at the Press Lounge Restaurant and agrees to another date with Fisk, as long as he agrees to tell the truth, and he agrees, wanting to be honest with her.[151][145]
  • Turk Barrett meets with Vladimir and, under orders from Wesley, reveals to him that he knows the owner of the garage that cleaned the car used to kill Anatoly, and that the owner was Fisk. Vladimir believes the Masked Man is working for Fisk, so he tells Barrett to put a bounty on Fisk.[151][145]
  • Nelson and Page fix the plumbing in Cardenas' apartment, much to her delight. She insists on making dinner for the pair.[151][145]
  • Back at his apartment, Murdock has Temple read him Blake's messages, the most recent of which is a list of the Russians' locations, so Murdock leaves to find Vladimir at one of them.[151][145]
  • Over dinner, Fisk and Marianna discus Fisk's true work, and his dream to rebuild New York City. Marianna asks about his cufflinks and he decides to admit that he is a dangerous man, but that she will always be safe by his side.[151][145]
  • Nelson and Page have dinner together and discuss how he and Murdock had first met. Page asks about Marci Stahl, and he jokes that both he and Matt date the wrong girls. He mentions that Matt has to touch people's faces, and Page asks him to do that to her face, to see how it feels.[151][145]
  • Bombing of Hell's Kitchen:
    • One of Madame Gao's blind drug runners arrive at the Russian Hideout, and the Masked Man attacks the guards. Inside, the Russians arm themselves and are too late to realize the blind runner has the detonator to a series of bombs, which he activates, causing the hideout to explode.[151][145]
    • The building next to Cardenas' apartment explodes, interrupting Nelson and Page, who quickly rush to help Cardenas. After helping her, Nelson runs to see if anyone else needs help.[151][145]
    • Two other buildings explode, as Fisk and Marianna look on. Fisk tells her that he did this to rid the city of the Russian Mafia, which Marianna is glad to hear.[151][145]
  • In the aftermath of the explosions, Murdock rushes to find Ranskahov, who is escaping the area with Sergei.[151][145]
  • Berrett is paid by Wesley for his help with destroying the Russians, and thanks him for his conversation with Ranskahov, which made him act predictably.[151][145]
  • Chase of Vladimir Ranskahov:
    • Ranskahov and Sergei are attacked by the masked man, but are stopped by the NYPD.[151] The corrupt NYPD officers attempt to arrest Murdock, and kill Ranskahov, but Murdock escapes and fight the offers, during the scuffle, Ranskahov is hit by one of the officers. Murdock and Ranskahov are able to escape, but Sergei is killed by the officers.[119][145]
    • At the New York Bulletin Building, Ben Urich looks over his evidence in the Fisk case, but is interrupted by the new of the bombings. Urich notices that the buildings all belonged to the Russians.[119][145]
    • Wesley updates Fisk on the status of Ranskahov and the masked man. Fisk orders a manhunt for the pair.[119][145]
    • Christian Blake and Carl Hoffman search the Russian hideout for survivors, finding Ivan, who they kill, ordering their men to do the same.[119][145]
    • Murdock carries Ranskahov into an Abandoned Building and assess his injuries, and corrects Ranskahov, telling him he never killed Anatoly, and that it was Fisk.[119][145]
    • Nelson and Page bring Cardenas to Metro-General Hospital, and she is treated by Claire Temple. Temple gets a call from Murdock, asking her to walk him through saving Ranskahov's life. Begrudgingly she agrees and instructs him on how to use a flare to cauterize his wound. Ranskahov's screams are heard by officer Sullivan outside, who follows the source of the sound. Murdock senses this and investigates.[119][145]
    • Murdock ambushes Sullivan and asks him to comply, but realizes he is not corrupt. Sullivan quickly calls for backup, and a squad of officers comply.[119][145]
    • Blake and Hoffman take control of the scene give the officers the run down. Urich arrives and asks for a statement. Wesley updates Fisk on the complication that Urich's presence introduces.[119][145]
    • Murdock handcuffs Sullivan and Ranskahov berates him for not using his gun. Murdock asks him for information of Fisk, adding that Fisk is gunning for the Russians, and has most of the NYPD in his pocket, so this is his only hope at survival. Ranskahov explains how Fisk invited him and his brother to join his operation. Ranskahov uses this time to attack Murdock, causing them both to fall down to the first floor, knocking them out.[119][145]
    • The press arrive on the scene, given info on the story by Wesley. Page sees the live broadcast and tries to contact Murdock. She and Nelson are worried when they don't get a reply.[119][145]
    • Murdock regains consciousness, and feels that Ranskahov's heart has stopped, but he preforms CPR and saves him.[119][145]
    • Wesley arranges for Fisk to have a walkie-talkie connection to Sullivan as a corrupt Emergency Service Unit arrive.[119][145]
    • Fisk calls Sullivan, and requests to speak to the masked man, Murdock answers. Fisk admits he admires what Murdock is trying to do, but that he is doing the wrong thing, so Murdock needs to end is search for him. An ESU Sniper gets into position, as Fisk tells Murdock that the entire city is blaming Murdock for the bombings, as he is protecting Ranskahov. Fisk asks Murdock to kill him in exchange for letting him go, but Murdock refuses and finds an entrance to the sewer under the building. Fisk promises that the masked man's reputation will be destroyed by him, so Fisk orders the sniper begin killing officers, including Blake.[119][145]
    • Nelson and Page see the news broadcast blame the masked man for both the bombings, and the shootings. Page is shocked at this, due to him saving her life.[119][145]
    • Temple calls Murdock and tells him about the news, but he says his goodbyes to her, in case he is unable to escape. A corrupt police unit breach the building, and Ranskahov helps Murdock to open the sewer grate, refusing to die here.[119][145]
    • The officers find Sullivan and kill him.[119][145]
    • Murdock and Ranskahov head into the sewer, but are pursued by the police. Murdock protects Ranskahov and fights off the officers. Ranskahov stays on the ground, and decides to die fighting, believing there is no way for him to stop Fisk or make it out alive. He reveals that Leland Owlsley is in charge of all of Fisk's holdings and money. Ranskahov makes his final stand shoots at the officers as Murdock makes his escape.[119][145]
  • Nelson and Cardenas' injuries are tended to.[152][145]

27th

  • In Tokyo, Aito is ambushed by Stick, who demands to know the location of the Black Sky. Stick cuts off the mans hand, asking him for the location again. The man reveals it is on a boat heading for New York City, so Stick kills him.[152][145]

28th

  • The New York Bulletin publishes an article about the Masked Man's involvement in the recent bombings and shooting, titled "The Devil of Hell's Kitchen."[152][145]
  • Foggy Nelson, Karen Page, and Matt Murdock discuss the events of the last couple days, with Nelson voicing his distain for the Masked Man. Murdock and Page attempt to calm Nelson down, knowing the paper is using speculation. Murdock says goodnight to Page and Nelson, as he stays to work on Elena Cardenas' case.[152][145]
  • Leland Owlsley meets with Nobu Yoshioka and informs him that his share of the Russian's holdings have been transferred, and tries to pry Yoshioka's plans, but to no avail. Once Nobu leaves, the Masked Man interrogates Owlsley, but Owlsley simply tases him and leaves. Stick arrives and belittles Murdock for his failure.[152][145]
  • Page meets with Ben Urich, and explains her findings about how Union Allied Construction was split into a number of other companies. Urich shares his findings on the Yakuza, the Triad, and the Russian Mafia's involvement.[152][145]
  • Stick and Murdock go to Murdock's apartment and Stick berates Murdock for his life full of luxury and comfort, saying he needs to be a warrior, leading to a brief scuffle. Murdock is able to stop Stick, who applauds his fighting prowess. Stick reminds him of the war against the Hand, and that Murdock needs to be able to kill people to survive. Stick asks for help in killing the Black Sky, since it will hurt Wilson Fisk, Murdock agrees, on the condition he not kill anyone.[152][145]
  • Page goes to Elena Cardenas' Apartment and helps her with her groceries, and asks Cardenas for more information regarding Westmeyer-Holt Contracting, she shares the description of two men. As she leaves, Page is attacked by the two men Cardenas described, Nelson uses a baseball bat to knock out the two men, helping Page to get away.[152][145]
  • Attack on Black Sky:
    • Murdock and Stick survey the docks where the ship holding the Black Sky has come to port, noting the high number of men with Nobu Yoshioka.[152][145]
    • The pair split up, with Murdock thinning out the group of men guarding the area. The shipping container is opened, revealing the young boy that is the Black Sky. Stick aims his bow to kill the boy, but Murdock stops this by kicking the arrow before it can kill the boy. With their cover blown, the Japanese open fire on the pair. The boy is placed into a car and driven away as Stick and Murdock fend off the men.[152][145]
    • As Murdock fights off the men, Stick catches up to the car and kills the young boy.[152][145]
  • Back at Murdock's apartment, Murdock scolds Stick for attempting to kill the child, but Stick refutes that that was no child, and that his death was necessary, admitting that he killed him while Murdock was fighting Yoshioka's men. Enraged, Murdock kick Stick, and the pair have another brief fight. Stick berates Murdock for his inability to kill, or even to beat a man as old as himself. He yells for Murdock to get up before he is able to defeat his former mentor. The pair catch their breath, and Murdock tells Stick to get out of his city.[152] [145]
  • At the New York Bulletin Building, Page and Nelson meets with Ben Urich, who berates her for telling Nelson the details of their plan, but the pair ultimately decide to fill him in.[152][145]
  • As Murdock cleans up the mess left behind by Stick in his apartment, he discovers that Stick had left the bracelet made from the ice cream wrapper he had gifted him twenty years prior, saddening him.[152][145]
  • Stick meets with Stone and informs him of his success in killing the Black Sky.[152][145]

29th

  • Wilson Fisk wakes up and looks at Rabbit in a Snowstorm before going about his morning routine.[153][145]
  • Fisk sits down and enjoys an omelet as the sun rises, then gets dressed and puts on his cufflinks.[153][145]
  • Matt Murdock wakes up and gets ready for the day.[153][145]
  • Foggy Nelson and Karen Page argue over the Union Allied Construction case, and decide to fill Murdock in on it as he walks into the office. The pair fill Murdock in on the two men who attacked Page last night. Murdock voices his concerns for everyone's saftey, but agrees to help.[153][145]
  • Fisk and James Wesley meet with Nobu Yoshioka, who is upset over the Black Sky's death. Fisk apologizes, but contests that he kept the area clear of police as he promised, and that its death is not on him.[153][145]
  • That night, Fisk calls Vanessa to tell her goodnight, but is interrupted by Wesley informing him of Christian Blake regaining conciseness at the hospital. Fisk orders Wesley to schedule a meeting between he and Carl Hoffman.[153][145]
  • At the office, Nelson, Murdock, and Page conduct more research, and discover Westmeyer-Holt Contracting belongs to Confederated Global Investments, and Page informs the others of Blake waking up.[153][145]
  • Fisk and Wesley order Hoffman to kill his partner, Blake due to him having sensitive information, much to his displeasure.[153][145]
  • Assassination of Christian Blake: Saddened by what he must do, Hoffman arrives at Metro-General Hospital and administers a fast-acting poison to kill Blake, but moments before he dies, the Masked Man arrives and asks Blake for information. Wanting to get back at Fisk for his betrayal, Blake shares all that he knows before dying.[153][145]
  • Leland Owlsley and Fisk meet with Melvin Potter, who fits them with new protective suits. Wesley informs the duo of Blake's death and the Masked man's interference.[153][145]

December

  • Samantha Reyes is honored by The New York Trial Lawyers Association. "Awarded On Behalf Of The Board And Membership In Recognition And Appreciation Of Her Service To The Profession"[154]
  • The SayHerName movement begins.[3][155]

1st

  • In his his penthouse, Wilson Fisk wakes up and goes about his morning routine.[153][145]
  • Fisk makes an omelet and enjoys the sunrise before getting dressed. Fisk receives a call from James Wesley, informing Fisk of Madame Gao's impending arrival.[153][145]
  • Gao and Fisk discus business over tea. She brings up Nobu Yoshioka's current displeasure, noting that it has added to her feeling that Fisk has gotten sloppy. She tells Fisk to restore order in his organization, or she will have to cut him out. Now alone, Fisk flips the table in rage.[153][145]
  • Concerned, Welsey calls Vanessa Marianna to comfort Fisk, who has been angry for hours. Fisk expresses his fear in sharing the truth with her, but she urdges him to always be honest. Fisk recounts the murder of his father, and that he wears his father's cufflinks as a reminder that he is not cruel for the sake of it, like his father was. Marianna comforts him as he voices his frustration at the city's attempts to stop him, admitting that he will not let them continue.[153][145]
  • While heading to his car, Ben Urich is approched by the Man in the Mask. Murdock tells Urich that he was not responsible for the Bombing of Hell's Kitchen, or the shootings, and reveals that Wilson Fisk is the man responsible. Urich admits that he has never heard of him, and that the public hates the masked man, so the man asks Urich to write an article to change the public's perception and reveal the truth. Urich agrees to do it, due to Page's trust in the masked man, but he says he needs sources.[153][145]

2nd

  • Using the information given to him by the Masked Man, Ben Urich begins drafting a New York Bulletin article exposing Wilson Fisk's corruption.[153][145]
  • Fisk wakes up and enjoys an omelet, now joined by Vanessa Marianna.[153][145]
  • Marianna helps Fisk get ready, and selects different cufflinks that his usual pair.[153][145]
  • Urich continues to draft his article, but stops to look at Fisk on the tv. WHiH World News broadcasts Fisk as he tells the people of New York City that he plans to no longer hide in the shadows, despite the danger the Man in the Mask poses. Fisk slanders the Masked Man, saying that his intimidation and terrorism will not stop him from fighting for the city and doing what he believes is right, announcing his Better Tomorrow Initiative and its goals. Karen Page and Foggy Nelson both watch the broadcast in horror. Urich deletes his article draft, knowing it has now been made useless. In his apartment, Matt Murdock listens to the broadcast, but is enraged by it, swiping his laptop onto the ground in frustration.[153][145]

3rd

  • Outside Clinton Church, Paul Lantom greets Matt Murdock, who takes Lantom up on his offer for coffee.[156][145]
  • Inside, Murdock asks if Lantom believes in the devil. Lantom divulges that he does, sharing a story of a mission trip he participated in during the Rwandan genocide, where a beloved village elder was brutally murdered in cold blood.[156][145]
  • At the Nelson and Murdock Law Office, Murdock, Karen Page, Foggy Nelson, and Ben Urich meet to discuss Wilson Fisk's announcement from the day prior, knowing now that it will be nearly impossible to share the truth about him. Urich shares the information about Leland Owlsley and James Wesley that the Masked Man provide him with, but Murdock admits it is simply hearsay, and they need more evidence.[156][145]
  • Wesley informs Fisk that his approval numbers are rising, and that Randolph Cherryh wishes to have a meeting. Fisk asks for more information on Carl Hoffman, who is currently missing. Nobu Yoshioka storms in, upset that he has not been given the city block he was promised. Knowing the Masked Man is impeding Fisk's progress, Yoshioka agrees to kill him.[156][145]
  • Elena Cardenas visits Nelson, Murdock, and Page, informing them that Fisk has doubled the offer for her apartment building. They urge her not to take the deal, to which she agrees. Murdock heads to Scene Contempo Gallery to investigate Vanessa Marianna.[156][145]
  • At the gallery, Murdock is greeted by Marianna. She helps Murdock choose some art to decorate his apartment, and is introduced to Wilson Fisk. Murdock feigns ignorance, and makes polite small talk with Fisk, but excuses himself and ends the conversation.[156][145]
